subtitle: כתאב אלאמאנאת ואלאעתקאדאת — The Book of Beliefs and Opinions
author: Saadia Gaon (882–942)

aligned.ja: וינקלוא אליה גלאתהא, ובהא יצל אלי אסתכ'ראג' אלמא מן עמק אלארץ' חתי צאר עלי וג'ההא
aligned.en: — and by it he transports their produce to him; and by it he reaches the extraction of water from the depths of the earth until it rises to its surface.

pairs.en: transports their produce to him
extraction of water from the depths of the earth

aligned.ja: בל צנע לה אלנואעיר אלתי תסתקי מנהא, ובהא יצל אלי בנא אלמנאזל אלסריה ולבאס אלת'יאב אלפאכ'רה ואצלאח אלאטעמה אללד'יד'ה
aligned.en: Indeed, he built for himself water wheels from which to draw it; and by wisdom he attains building splendid dwellings, wearing fine garments, and preparing delicious foods.

pairs.en: water wheels from which to draw water
building splendid dwellings
preparing delicious foods

aligned.ja: ובהא יצל אלי קוד אלג'יוש ואלעסאכר ותדביר אלמלך ואלסלטאן חתי אנצ'בט אלנאס ותסקמוא
aligned.en: By it he attains the leading of armies and troops, the governance of kingdoms and states, until people are organized and settled.

pairs.en: leading of armies and troops
governance of kingdoms and states

aligned.ja: ובהא יצל אלי עלם היאהֵ אלפלך ומסיר אלנג'ום ומקאדיר אג'ראמהא ואבעאדהא וסאיר אחואלהא
aligned.en: By it he attains knowledge of the structure of the celestial sphere, the motion of the stars, the measures of their bodies, their distances, and all their states.

pairs.en: knowledge of the celestial sphere and motion of stars
measures of their bodies and distances

aligned.ja: פאן תוהם מתוהם אן אלמפצ'ל הו שי גיר אלאנסאן פלירנא הד'א אלמפצ'ל או בעצ'ה בגירה וד'לך כלא לא יג'דה
aligned.en: If anyone imagines that what is distinguished is something other than the human being, let him show us this distinguished thing or any part of it among others — and that he will not find.

pairs.ja: אן אלמפצ'ל הו שי גיר אלאנסאן
pairs.en: what is distinguished is something other than the human being
let him show us this distinguished thing

aligned.ja: פבחק אן יכון אלאנסאן אלמאמור ואלמנהי ואלמת'אב ואלמעאקב אד' הו קטב אלעאלם וקאעדתה
aligned.en: It is thus fitting that the human being is the one commanded and prohibited, rewarded and punished — for he is the axis of the world and its foundation.

pairs.en: the human being is commanded and prohibited
rewarded and punished
the axis of the world and its foundation

aligned.ja: פלמא תבינת הד'ה אלאצול ומא יתפרע מנהא עלמת אן תשריף אלאנסאן ליס הו והמא וקע פי נפוסנא, ולא מיל מלנא בה אלי מחאבאתה
aligned.en: When I understood these principles and what branches from them, I knew that the distinction of the human being is not a fantasy that arose in our minds, nor a partiality from which we are inclined to favor him.

pairs.en: the distinction of the human being is not a fantasy
nor a partiality that inclines us to favor him

aligned.ja: אלא חק צחיח וצדק מבין, ולם ישרפה אלחכים בהד'א אלאמר אלא לאנה ג'עלה מוצ'עא לאמרה ונהיה
aligned.en: Rather, it is genuine truth and clear rightness. The Wise One distinguished him for this very reason: that He made him the locus of His command and prohibition.

pairs.en: genuine truth and clear rightness
made him the locus of His command and prohibition

aligned.ja: פרק. ב. וינבגי אן ארסם מא פרדתה פי הד'א אלבאב ממא יחתאג' אליה ואקול, אני תפכרת פקלת, כיף יכון אלמעול מן ג'מיע מא פי אלעאלם עלי אלאנסאן, פהוד'א נשאהד ג'סמה צגירא חקירא
aligned.en: Section 2. I should now set out what I have designated in this chapter of what is required. I say: I reflected and asked myself — how can the world's whole weight rest on the human being, when we see his body to be small and insignificant?

pairs.en: the world's weight rests on the human being
we see his body to be small and insignificant

aligned.ja: פתת'בת פי ד'לך פוג'דתה ועלי אן ג'סמה צגיר פנפסה אוסע מן אלסמא ואלארץ', אד' יחיט עלמה במא פיהמא
aligned.en: I pursued this and found: although his body is small, his soul is vaster than heaven and earth — for his knowledge encompasses what is in them both.

pairs.en: his body is small
his soul is vaster than heaven and earth
his knowledge encompasses what is in them

aligned.ja: נעם חתי בלגת אלי אלמערפה במא פוקהמא אלד'י בה יכון קואמהמא אעני אלבארי תעאלי ותקדס
aligned.en: Indeed, it extends to knowledge of what is above them — what sustains their very existence — namely, the Creator (exalted and sanctified).

pairs.en: knowledge of what is above them
what sustains their very existence
namely the Creator, exalted and sanctified
